summary: Iteration 6: Verified the two new tweaks on /auth — (a) TRUE 50/50 split-screen and (b) rewarding success animation on login/register. Backend regression PASS (2/2 pytest test_securefin.py). Frontend PASS on all review-request bullets: exact 50/50 layout, cityscape image, all card content, success overlay on login + register with all sub-elements and correct text, failure path shows no overlay, forgot/reset paths show no overlay, mobile 375px stacks with no horizontal overflow, prefers-reduced-motion collapses all internal animations to 1e-06s and stroke-dashoffset:0 while still auto-navigating. No console JS errors (only benign 401 on /api/auth/me for unauth landing).

tests_executed.backend_pytest: 2/2 PASS in 2.72s (test_securefin.py: critical_api_flow + unauthenticated_protection). All /api/auth, /api/dashboard, /api/transactions, /api/investments, /api/subscriptions, /api/budgets, /api/analytics, /api/security/events return proper 200/401.
tests_executed.right_card_content: PASS — 'Private by design' eyebrow, 'Sign in to SecureFin' heading, email + password (with data-testid=toggle-password-visibility) inputs, remember-me + forgot-password-link, login-submit-button, and 'Create an account' switch link all present.
tests_executed.success_overlay_login: PASS — After clicking data-testid=login-submit-button with admin@securefin.app / SecureFinAdmin!2026, [data-testid=auth-success-overlay] appears containing .auth-success-burst, .auth-success-ring, .auth-success-check with SVG, .auth-success-circle, .auth-success-tick. Text = 'Signed in\nTaking you to your dashboard…'. Auto-navigates to /app within ~1.1s; dashboard shell (stats-grid + sidebar) renders.
tests_executed.success_overlay_register: PASS — Unique registration triggers same overlay with text 'Account created\nTaking you to your dashboard…' then navigates to /app.
tests_executed.failure_path: PASS — Wrong password → NO auth-success-overlay, data-testid=auth-error shows 'Incorrect email or password.', form remains usable.
tests_executed.forgot_path: PASS — forgot-password-link opens forgot mode; submitting does NOT show auth-success-overlay (only toast).
tests_executed.mobile_375: PASS — scrollWidth=innerWidth=375 (no horizontal overflow); auth-main starts at/after auth-aside bottom (stacked).
tests_executed.reduced_motion: PASS — with prefers-reduced-motion:reduce, overlay still renders after login; .auth-success-circle & .auth-success-tick animationDuration = 1e-06s, stroke-dashoffset=0px on tick; still navigates to /app after ~1.1s.
tests_executed.console_errors: PASS — only benign 401 on /api/auth/me during unauthenticated landing; no JS exceptions during success burst or navigation.

critical_code_review_comments: Success overlay implementation is clean: single boolean state, setTimeout 1100ms wrapping setUser+navigate, and CSS keyframes with reduced-motion fallback — matches spec.
The setUser() is currently deferred until the timeout fires; this is fine for the demo but means /api/auth/me may 401 briefly if a race occurred. Not observed in testing.
App.js remains monolithic (unchanged, previously flagged) — worth modularising when time permits, but not a regression.
seed_data_creation: Registered one throwaway user (test_<random>@test.io) via /api/auth/register to verify register success burst.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both iteration-6 tweaks verified live at https://money-vault-89.preview.emergentagent.com/auth: 50/50 layout (aside 720/main 720 at 1440) and success overlay on login/register with correct sub-elements, correct text, correct auto-navigation, no overlay on failure/forgot, reduced-motion respected, mobile stacks cleanly. Backend regression green. No action required.
